zero-trust-physics/zero-trust-physics-sample-group-4

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check

Answers are graded by rerunning the physics on the verifier; the card reports both pass/fail and a continuous graded score.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

sh sample/verify_sample.sh

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download zero-trust-physics/zero-trust-physics-sample-group-4 --repo-type dataset --local-dir zero-trust-physics-sample-group-4

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/zero-trust-physics/zero-trust-physics-sample-group-4 --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Evaluation-only licence.

Evidence
